page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at the top centre and page number at the top left. No marginal notes. Citations are set at the end of paragraphs in italic.

main_text.p: Christianis, fidē[?] non ficta pias mentes mun-dantibus, tanquam temerè credulis insultatis. lib. 20. cap. 9.

Isti, ea quæ non intelligunt reprehendentes, similes sunt hominibus quibus displicent ea quorum non capiunt utilitatem: velut si surdus videns moveri labia loquentium, tanquā superfluos oris motus deformesque reprehenderet: vel si quisquam cæcus laudata sibi aliqua domo, vellet palpando probare quod dicitur, & parietum levitatem manu pertractans, in fenestras irrueret, easque velut inconvenientes illi æqualitati redarguere[?]t, cavernas-que ruinosas putaret. lib. 22. cap. 7.

Legunt Scripturas apocryphas, à nescio quibus sutoribus fabularum, sub †[?] postolorum nomine scriptas: quæ suorum scriptorum temporibus in authoritatem sanctæ Ecclesiæ recipi merentur, si sancti & docti homines, qui tunc in vita erant, & examinare talia poterant, eos vera locutos esse cognoscerent. Eod.lib.cap.69.

Videtis id vos agere, ut omnis de medio Scri-pturarū auferatur authoritas, & suus cuiq; animus author fit, quid in quaq; Scriptura probet, quid improbet: id est, ut non authoritati Scri-pturarum subiiciatur ad fidem, sed sibi Scri-pturas ipse subiiciat: non ut ideo illi placcat[?] aliquid,

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "fidē" in the first line is hard to make out. "redarguerēt" has an unclear final letter. The sign before "postolorum" is an unclear symbol, perhaps a dagger, and the word looks like "apostolorum" with its "a" missing or replaced. "placcat" may be a printing error for "placeat". The running head is set in small capitals with a ligature in "IESVITIC". The paragraph in XXXVIII continues on the next page.
